label: Swiss Elites
description: The Swiss Elites knowledge graph contains prosopographical data about Swiss political, economic, military, cultural and academic elites from the 19th and 20th centuries, modelled using WissKI and Linked Open Data principles. Ontologies: CIDOC CRM and SDHSS (social-life-core, shortcuts).
intro: A natural-language interface to the **Elites Suisses** knowledge graph of the [LESSH project](https://elites-suisses.lod4hss.org/) (Université de Lausanne / Universität Bern). Ask in English or French about Swiss political, economic, academic and military figures of the 19th–20th centuries: their mandates and memberships, studies, families and marriages.
example_questions: How many persons are in the database?
How many birth events are recorded?
Who are the recorded parents of a given person?
How many persons of each SDHSS class are there?
topics: Swiss elites, political figures, historical persons, social networks, and prosopographical data
org: University of Lausanne - Swiss Elites project
